description.zh:
创建频道时间，支持查询最近30天的数据。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。
> 创建频道时间必须与实际创建时间完全一致（精确到秒）。您可以通过调用接口[DescribeCallList](~~2655884~~)查看创建频道时间（返回的CreatedTS参数）。
description.en:
Channel creation time. Supports querying data from the last 30 days, represented as a UNIX timestamp, in seconds.  
> The channel creation time must exactly match the actual creation time (accurate to the second). You can obtain the channel creation time by invoking the [DescribeCallList](~~2655884~~) API (see the returned CreatedTS parameter).

description.zh:
释放频道时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。参数为空表示获取当前时间。
> 如果传入的频道释放时间超过真实的释放时间，将返回从创建时间开始到真实释放时间之间的数据。
description.en:
Channel release time, represented as a UNIX timestamp, in seconds. If the parameter is empty, the current time is used.  
> If the provided channel release time exceeds the actual release time, data from the creation time to the actual release time will be returned.

description.zh: 查询的扩展。取值：USER_DURATION_STAT：用户时长统计数据类型。
description.en: The extension to query. Valid value: USER_DURATION_STAT: user duration statistics data type.

description.zh: 是否查询通信体验信息，不传默认是true。
description.en: Specifies whether to query communication experience information. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is true.

title.en: Query details of a single communication session

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于查询单次通信详情。例如：您可以查询通讯状态、用户详情等信息。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### How-To  
This API is used to query the details of a single communication session. For example, you can query the communication status, user details, and other information.  
### queries per second (QPS) Limit  
The QPS limit for this API is 10 queries per second per user. If this limit is exceeded, API calls will be subject to rate limiting, which may impact your business. Invoke the API appropriately.
